text:
Nora: Short follow-up from today's all-hands re: the service interruption. RCA is live here: https://redwood.company/rca/INC-2026-042. Using this thread to capture owners, short ETAs, and the leadership Q&A items. Keep replies to one line where possible. :notebook:

Ethan: I'll own the rollback playbook + canary test script. ETA: 2026-03-28 08:00 UTC. Will add steps to `ops/playbooks/kv-rollback.md` and include rollback verification commands.

Rui: I'll take the runbook updates and detection tuning. Will add new alert thresholds and a short remediation checklist. ETA: 2026-03-28 13:00 UTC.

Priya: I'll draft the customer-facing update for Hosted + Dedicated tiers and coordinate Legal/PR signoff. Draft 1 by 2026-03-28 18:00 UTC.

DeployBot: Created follow-up ticket INC-2026-042-ALLHANDS and linked tasks: https://redwood.company/tasks/INC-2026-042-ALLHANDS.

Nora: Leadership Qs to capture in thread: 1) Will SLOs change? 2) Any immediate Dedicated capacity guarantees? 3) Who is on 7-day regression watch?

Ethan: No SLO change today. If rollback fails to restore baseline within 72h we will propose a temporary guardrail adjustment.

Rui: Ops can provision a 48h Dedicated buffer for critical accounts with manual approval; I'll prepare the approval request once we have the list.

Priya: Platform Reliability will run the 7-day elevated watch; I'll post a daily morning snapshot in this thread.

Ethan: Rollback verification commands I'll include in the playbook:
```
# restart cache proxy and check metrics
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/kv-proxy
curl -sS http://internal-metrics/kv | jq .hit_rate
```

Rui: Proposed alert expression for Prometheus: `sum(rate(kv_cache_miss_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m])) > 0.02`. I'll add a Grafana panel and link it in the runbook.

Priya: Draft comms link: https://redwood.company/drafts/comm-INC-2026-042. Tagging @Legal and @PR for review.

Nora: Please post the final doc/task links here. I'll assemble the consolidated action tracker and schedule a 48h sync. One extra ask from leadership: drop a 2-3 line "what we changed" summary for the next all-hands slide by EOD tomorrow.

Ethan: Blurb: "Rolled back a KV cache change, updated detection thresholds, and instituted a 7-day elevated monitoring window with targeted Dedicated capacity options."

Rui: Runbook + alert updated: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/kv-cache. Added remediation steps and verification checks.

DeployBot: Follow-up ticket updated with assignees and ETAs. Next status update due 2026-03-29 09:00 UTC.

Nora: Thanks everyone. Closing comments only; append links if you have them so I can export the tracker. :white_check_mark:
